lead: A representation that can hold `null` has six lowering sites, not the four a `grep` for `Ty::Tagged` finds — and `==` against a written `null` is the one that looks covered and is not.
body: Five are where they look (`lower_coalesce`, `lower_isset_operand`, `truthy_convert`, `coerce`, `lower_binary`); the sixth is `lower_expr`'s own dispatch arm, which routes `$x == null` to `lower_null_identity` when one side is the literal, so a row added to `lower_binary` is dead for the spelling every test writes and a null value compares unequal to `null`. See `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs`.
